name: mileage-log
description: Mileage logging app for Pacifica Landscapes: automatic trips, one-tap classification, IRS-ready reports.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mileage/shared && npm run build -w @mileage/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mileage/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mileage/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @mileage/shared && npm run dev -w @mileage/api
